proposals.issue_title: Runaway Spend Risk on Runware PAYG API
proposals.current_pain_description: Transitioning to Runware PAYG (€20/month budget) introduces the risk of infinite loops in GitHub Actions burning the entire monthly budget in minutes if a script fails to break a loop or encounters 4xx/5xx retries.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a centralized `utils/rate_limiter.py` that reads and updates a committed `state/budget_ledger.json` tracking daily spending. Before any paid API call, the script must verify that the daily spend (e.g., max €0.66/day) has not been exceeded, otherwise failing gracefully with a warning.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves up to €20/month in accidental API overspend and prevents account suspensions.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Failures of Low-Quality Images in Print Pipelines
proposals.current_pain_description: Images generated via Pollinations or experimental models are often blurry, grey, or anatomically broken, but currently pass straight to compilation, resulting in unmarketable final products.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a mandatory validation step using the free Gemini 2.5 Flash model inside `agent_gemini_quality_check`. Pass the generated image via base64 to Gemini with a strict checklist prompt (e.g., 'Is this strictly black and white? Is the line art clean? Are there weird artifact loops? Answer YES or NO'). If NO, trigger a single automated retry with adjusted prompt weights.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 100% automated quality control, ensuring only high-quality, sellable assets are compiled into books/cards.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Print-Ready PDF Compilation
proposals.current_pain_description: Compiling individual images into a single, correctly-formatted KDP PDF (handling bleed, page margins, and inserting blank backing pages to prevent ink bleed-through) is tedious or impossible to do manually on a mobile phone via Termux.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add an automated compilation step using `reportlab` or `fpdf2` in Python at the end of the generation workflows. The script must auto-calculate margins, insert blank pages on odd indices, enforce 300 DPI, and output a perfect, print-ready PDF directly to the GitHub Actions artifact/release.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves Hugo 1-2 hours of tedious manual formatting per book; enables pure mobile-to-KDP publishing.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions Runner Timeout and State Loss
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating a full 40-50 page coloring book in a single GitHub Actions run takes time. If the runner hits a rate limit or times out at page 38, all intermediate generated images are lost, wasting time and API quotas.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement incremental state saving. After each successful image generation, commit the asset and metadata to a temporary branch (e.g., `drafts/coloring-book-1`) or push to a GitHub Actions cache. The pipeline should always check this state on startup and resume from the last successfully generated page.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates wasted API costs and workflow hours due to unexpected timeouts or network drops.

proposals.issue_title: Inefficient Mobile Interface for Workflow Management
proposals.current_pain_description: Managing, triggering, and viewing logs of 20+ GitHub Actions workflows via the GitHub mobile web interface on an Android screen is incredibly frustrating and slow.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a simple, free Telegram Bot or Discord Webhook integration in the orchestration workflows. Hugo can trigger pipelines with simple text commands (e.g., `/generate coloring 'dragons'`) and receive completion notifications with PDF download links directly on his phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces administrative friction on mobile by 80%, making the 10h/week limit much more productive.

proposals.current_pain_description: A high-quality asset generated for a coloring book is only used once. It is not automatically reformatted into other digital products like SVGs, stickers, or tumbler wraps, leaving money on the table.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create an automated 'asset pooler' script. When an asset passes the Gemini visual audit with a perfect score, it is automatically copied to an `/assets/approved/` directory. A secondary automated cron job packages these assets into vector SVGs (via Potrace), pattern wraps, or stickers, creating 3-4 distinct products from a single generation cost.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory volume and revenue potential by 3x to 4x for the exact same API generation cost.
